_doc: Maps every real (or founder-specified) business entity to its synthetic digital-twin counterpart. Exists so 'which real record does this synthetic one mirror' is always answerable from the repo alone, and so a wrong-target mutation can be detected by comparing against the real canonical id recorded here. Written only by the Fable QA Director.
_naming_rules: The real-name portion is copied BYTE-FOR-BYTE from the actual canonical record - never abbreviated, translated, normalized, or reconstructed from shorthand prose. e.g. 'SEM Global Robotics Technologies LLC — SYNTHETIC QA [...]', NOT 'SEM GRT LLC — SYNTHETIC QA [...]'.
The em-dash separator and the bracketed campaign tag are the visible synthetic marker. They are what lets a human instantly distinguish a QA twin from the real record in the same list.
Synthetic clones ALWAYS get a different canonical DB id from the real entity. Same display-name prefix, different id - that is the deliberate entity-resolution pressure.

Synthetic PEOPLE preserve the real display name and business role, but NEVER real contact info/credentials. Emails use the RFC-2606 reserved .invalid TLD (e.g. aldajan.c001w1@example.invalid) so no message can ever physically be delivered.
_source_origin_note: CANONICAL_RECORD = a real Brain OS row exists; real_canonical_id is populated and was read read-only to copy the exact name. FOUNDER_SPEC = the founder explicitly supplied this as a real intended business entity but no Brain OS record exists yet; real_canonical_id is null BY DESIGN (do not fabricate a real record just to satisfy the schema). SCENARIO_DERIVED = invented for a test scenario with no real-world counterpart claimed.

real_entities_resolved_readonly._note: Resolved read-only 2026-08-31 to obtain exact canonical display names. These REAL records are never mutated by QA. Any mutation landing on one of these ids is a P0/P1 wrong-target defect.
not_found_in_brain_os: SpoonTech LLC — founder-specified as IQParking's owning client; no companies row exists. Recorded as FOUNDER_SPEC when its twin is created, real_canonical_id null.

_clones_note: Populated as the C001 IQParking digital twin is built. Each entry: real_entity_type, real_canonical_id (nullable iff source_origin=FOUNDER_SPEC), real_display_name, source_origin, synthetic_canonical_id, synthetic_display_name, campaign_id, worker_id, clone_purpose, created_at, cleanup_status.
